title: 🔁 SPN-156 Sync saved edits while the file list is open
body:
Saved offline edits previously waited for their editor to reopen even when the running file list reconnected. This adds an account-scoped owner that replays one eligible downloaded Doc or Sheet through the existing native sync client, authority checks and durable checkpoint path. Foreground editing quiets and joins replay before taking the item writer; cleanup failures cannot strand the foreground admission waiter.

🚧 **Draft validation candidate; actual acceptance incomplete.** Source `40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47` against base `754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a`. Do not merge or represent provisional ticket removal as completion until the remaining browser and installed-phone evidence, current-head gates and exact-head reviews are complete.

## 🧭 Scope and decisions

The complete **L, pre-launch** outcome retains editor-independent Doc/Sheet replay; account/item authority and revocation; exclusive writer ownership; persisted snapshot/outbox acknowledgement; exactly-once retry, interruption and recovery; separate-viewer content; and a bounded installed-phone lifecycle observation. Closed-app OS background execution, polling, offline image/creation changes and iPhone acceptance (SPN-152) are outside this ticket.

[Original full ticket](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a/docs/todo/SPN-156.md), [canonical decisions, full evidence and retained acceptance](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/blob/40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47/docs/implementation/SPN-156.md), [complete source diff](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/compare/754e65317744e5ce97ede501935c6586e4875f2a...40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47).

All four personas informed the accepted design. Owner retains durable work and foreground priority; Collaborator receives native content through the existing access/revocation path; Operator gets bounded work using existing components; Link guest receives no private replay owner or local account store. Lost-ack attention remains conservative; denied/incompatible work stays recoverable without hidden recovery-copy publication. This changes wiring among existing pending/synced/attention states, with no new component or visual design. Existing rendering and interaction checks remain applicable; no routine new-state visual matrix is claimed.

Later candidate commits only add evidence/provenance. Root's exact `40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47` PR-shape check passed **449 ms / 188,768 KiB**. [Integrated receipts](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-156/integration-754e6531).
- **176/176** lifecycle/persistence tests passed at `ff0f12018ea92caaa9b09f48064962326f8061ae`. All **16 ticket-owned runtime/test blobs** remain identical through the reviewed and current integration. The native probe proves actual Doc text/Sheet cell checkpoint restoration and durable acknowledgement; removing restoration fails on missing content. Real host/session cleanup and store transaction completion/error controls pass; restoring the old cleanup bug fails directly on missing completion signalling. [Native and cleanup evidence](https://github.com/mxbaylee/spinel/tree/40dee0d32cd3cce4bd9c1cbea74aeccdd1d83b47/docs/implementation/evidence/SPN-156).
- All **117** manifest, lock, production library and dependency-script inputs match the dependency baseline. The actual post-check donor HEAD was `23e7553ff4f35f5f03dfe51a644840994e52929e` (working cleanliness not captured then); the later recheck observed clean `5e72d33ac9cb3a86b3496345209493d6c86e469c` with the same inputs. Historical `2204b8c4` is a comparison baseline, not a claim about current donor HEAD. No shared dependency/cache mutation or install occurred.
- The repaired production bundle built at `229e97684d404f9bd0908650f095055b2d4d4e11`: **1,212 ms / 910,176 KiB**, runtime `43c309cb3e283134`, entry `/assets/application-DjvUEl9z.js`, index SHA-256 `a991525f63faa5ef058362fed495af4d4f2ff54dfaecf53a9dc69088975d5768`. It is historical build evidence; final hosted acceptance must bind its own build and server to the final integrated head.

All local workloads retained the normal-pressure, 2 GiB and eight-minute guards. Owned-process/port audits were empty after targeted cleanup; no owner app was killed. No unchanged local browser retry or budget increase is proposed.

## 🔎 First failures and remaining acceptance

All **six** local browser attempts remain preserved, including their original sources and diagnostics:

1. The first failed before reconnect: existing saved status preceded a durable authored Doc checkpoint. The fixture now waits for actual distinctive checkpoint content; no replay pass was inferred.
2. The second was resource-aborted without a test result.
3. The third refused startup because the prior detached test server still held port 3105; exact PID/cwd/port ownership was verified and cleaned up.
4. The fourth used a smaller harness-only heap and was resource-aborted, without changing the app or assertions.
5. The fifth used reduced file-list preparation (each editor opened only for actual offline authorship) and was resource-aborted before a case started. Its associated earlier typecheck abort is retained; subsequent source-bound typechecks passed.
6. The sixth used the repaired bundle above and unchanged two-case fixture; the first case started but the run exceeded **2,097,152 KiB** at **2,103,424 KiB / 10,938 ms** before an assertion result. The revoked-access case was not reached. Verified detached server PID 78389/PGID 78361 was cleaned up; listener and process audits were empty.

Hosted **Playwright smoke (sync-production)** must execute both authored cases in `e2e/offline-editing.spec.ts`: actual queued Doc+Sheet edits, browser IndexedDB acknowledgement, exact server revision/content and separate-viewer native content while the first page remains in the file list; and revoked-access queue retention without submission or recovery-copy creation. **Lib tests (remaining)** includes the real native checkpoint probe. Current routing retains all relevant app/shared-runtime/performance and aggregate gates. Queued, skipped, aborted or absent records are not passes. Preserve first-attempt JSON results and diagnostics, including failed attempts if later repaired.

The **installed-phone observation remains an unavailable execution prerequisite**, not a human product/design sign-off or provider gate. No authorized phone-control session has been established. The owner's earlier Pixel 10/latest Chrome/Home Screen symptom does not verify the repaired build. Obtain the already-authorized installed session when available, observe actual app-running reconnect/foreground and peer content, and record device/browser/build/scenario provenance. No phone pass or waiver is claimed.

SPN-158 and SPN-160 are integrated; there is no assumed SPN-159 prerequisite. Concrete current-head failures still require diagnosis and repair.

This body is the initial validation snapshot. A **verified, published terminal record** at the links above supersedes only the corresponding initial pending statuses, with its actual source/run/job/case identities and first-failure dispositions. An absent, incomplete or unverified record never establishes a pass. The installed-phone requirement is distinct: passing hosted browser/CI records do not resolve it; it needs its own verified device/build/scenario observation before full acceptance. If the candidate head changes, archive and review identities must follow the actual head rather than relabelling an old result. Before post-merge cleanup, recheck branch heads and active PR ownership, preserve unique code/evidence and delete only obsolete ticket-created refs with head guards.
